When performing calculations, please follow these guidelines:
Use same variable symbols as given in the question

message.content:
Let

I = ∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx

Using integration by parts twice:

I = exp(x)*sin(x) - ∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx

For J = ∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx:

J = exp(x)*cos(x) + ∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx
J = exp(x)*cos(x) + I

So:

I = exp(x)*sin(x) - (exp(x)*cos(x) + I)
2 * I = exp(x)*sin(x) - exp(x)*cos(x)
I = 1/2 * exp(x)*sin(x) - 1/2 * exp(x)*cos(x)

Therefore:

∫ 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx = 3 * I
= (3/2) * exp(x) * sin(x) - (3/2) * exp(x) * cos(x) + C

<answer>(3/2) * exp(x) * sin(x) - (3/2) * exp(x) * cos(x) + C</answer>
